usage: Refers to the metal copper. It is a common everyday noun and is used in both technical and general contexts.
Often appears in compounds and set phrases about materials, such as metal objects, wiring, alloys, and colors.
Can be used to describe a pure material or a component made mainly of copper; context usually makes the meaning clear.
In casual speech, 銅 is less common than more specific material words, so it sounds natural in shopping,工藝, science, and product descriptions.
